# BREW Utilities

**Author:** QUALCOMM Incorporated<br/>
**Platforms:** BREW

<div className="screenshot">

![BREW Utilities: screenshot 1](./brew-utilities/img/brew-utilities.png)

</div>

The package contains three utilities:

- BREW 2BitTool for converting images to the two-bit BREW format;
- NMEALogger for recording GPS data in NMEA format;
- PVConv for converting mono 8 kHz, 16-bit WAV files to Qualcomm PureVoice QCP and back.
